Firmware 0.9.9 and the manager app, rebuilt to match. The watch itself installs from a web page, no download needed: <https://partiallyfrozen.github.io/tilt-a-tron/>. A watch already on 0.8.0 or later updates from its own SETTINGS.

## New since 0.8.0

- **RADAR**, the eleventh game: a sea battle on a radar scope. Place your fleet by touching the ships, press and hold to aim, lift to drop, and the sweep comes round to say what was there. One bomb each, and the enemy's cross-hairs wander before it fires.
- **SLEEPY STAR** is rebuilt: the rings are dials you drag, like a combination lock, the laser stays put, and the star is a star.
- **STARFALL**: a chase down a trench, through blast gates, with mines, in levels. Its ships are sprites of our own, and anyone can put their own on.
- **SKATER GIRLZ** is rebuilt on Canabalt's mechanics and steered like a wheel; tap again in the air for a trick.
- **ECHO** is a touch game and nothing else; the winning pad lights, and there is no last round.
- **A power menu.** Hold PWR for six seconds: SLEEP, SHUT DOWN or RESTART, and the watch says which it is doing. A three-second boot animation says it is starting.
- **RESTART GAME** in every game's menu, and it means a fresh start.
- Wi-Fi sends about twice as fast, and says why when it does not start.
- **An emulator**: play and test a game on a PC, built from the console's own sources, and film what is played. See `tools/emu/README.md`.

## The manager app

The desktop program that puts games on a Tilt-a-tron and takes them off again. It has not changed since 0.8.0; these are the same builds with the new version number.

| You have | Take | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 | `tiltatron-manager-v0.9.9-windows-x64.exe` | Double-click it. |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `tiltatron-manager-v0.9.9-macos-arm64.tar.gz` | `tar -xzf` it, then see the note below. |
| Linux x64 | `tiltatron-manager-v0.9.9-linux-x64.tar.gz` | `tar -xzf` it and run `./tiltatron-manager`. |

Each is one self-contained file, about 40 MB. Plug the watch in with a cable that carries data, wake it, and the app finds it.

**These builds are not code-signed**, so each system will say so once:

- **Windows** shows "Windows protected your PC". Choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
- **macOS** refuses to open it. Clear the download flag first: `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine tiltatron-manager`
- **Linux** needs permission to use the serial port. On most distributions: `sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER`, then sign out and back in.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksum of every file.

Want to write a game? It is a folder of plain C, an icon and one script: see [Write a game](https://github.com/PartiallyFrozen/tilt-a-tron#write-a-game).

## Known

- Sending files to the watch over USB is slow (about 9 KB/s). A game takes a couple of seconds; a large theme takes half a minute.
- Dragging between the manager's panes has been tested far less than the buttons that do the same thing. If a drag misbehaves, the buttons will not.
